views.prompt: Full-body character reference for 3D modelling of a 47-year-old Baltic German-Russian fisherman: big, weathered, broad build, sun-tanned skin, short ginger-grey beard, short hair under a navy knitted watch cap; a yellow oilskin fisherman jacket, open, over a thick cream cable-knit sweater, dark blue canvas work trousers, tall black rubber boots. Strict T-pose: standing straight, arms stretched out horizontally to the sides at shoulder height, elbows straight, palms facing down, fingers together, feet shoulder width apart, flat on the floor. Neutral calm expression, mouth closed, eyes open. Whole body visible from the top of the hair to the soles of the shoes, centred, nothing cropped. Orthographic-looking views, camera at chest height. Plain light grey seamless studio background, soft even shadowless lighting, no props, no bag, no text, photorealistic, realistic body proportions.
